name: RELAY TRIVIA
description: A two-question equipment drill from the DEEP FIELD training shelf.

prompt: BENCH CARD: The dummy load absorbs the test signal at the bench. The antenna sends it out.
Which port gets the dummy load for a bench-only test?
retry: Follow the test signal from the transmitter to the load.

prompt: BENCH CARD: A room mic picks up nearby sound. Headphones keep the receiver audio at your ears.
Which kit lets you monitor the receiver without waking the night shift?
retry: Look for the kit that keeps audio at your ears.
